title: IOSN MA3 source manifest contract

selected_weather_ids.source: externally finalized; not inferable from Open-TYNDP's 3 scenario columns

source_interval_csv.timestamp: ISO-8601 with explicit offset matching IANA zone
source_interval_csv.interval: [start,end); contiguous, strictly positive duration; DAY or WEEK, partial final intervals supported
source_interval_csv.energy_unit: MWh per native interval; zero only if present in hashed real source

target_snapshot_csv.step: one hour; consecutive; no DST/local-time assumptions

closed_loop: HCL has a declared no-natural-inflow policy with evidence, not fabricated zeros

temporal_distribution.meaning: deterministic energy-conserving disaggregation only; not hourly hydro observation or generation
temporal_distribution.policy_evidence: mandatory even for fixtures; independent approval required for real use

raw_tyndp_csv_normalization.source_column: explicit WS###, never choose first available

pending_m0_contract_alignment: Current MA1 logical network_revision_id bridge must be reconciled with M0 CAN/2.0.0 canonical_revision_id+projection_id before real integration
